name: review_my_recent_activity
trigger_description: Show recent money in and out of the signed-in customer's own Dewy Bank accounts. Use this when the customer asks what has happened in an account, about a payment, or why a balance changed. Name the account the way the customer sees it, for example "Everyday Checking", or leave it empty for every account; call list_my_accounts first if you are not sure of the exact name. Optionally say how many entries to show. Returns a status (completed, refused or failed), a plain-language message, and the most recent activity, newest first: date, direction (money in or money out), amount, the other side, category and description.
